corrections.reason: The glyph after በ has the top and bottom horizontal bars of the Ethiopic numeral ፲ (በ፲ር = በዐሥር, the 10th day of the lunar month, i.e. the Day of Atonement / ዕለተ ዮሴፍ), which was misread as ሥ.
Both the image glyphs (6th-order እ and ጅ) and Andemta idiom confirm እጅም ('solitude / being alone inside the sanctuary'), which was misread as አጀም.
The printed text clearly shows የለ followed by a semicolon ፤ ('as for honey mead, there is not much in their country'), which Stage 1 misread as ያህል.
